amendments.trigger: Synthetic attack showed that generic DOJ investigation language could be misclassified as antitrust enforcement.
amendments.rule: ANTITRUST_ENFORCEMENT_SINGLE_NAME requires explicit title+slug language containing antitrust, competition authority, competition regulator, or monopoly in addition to an enforcement action. DOJ/FTC identity alone cannot establish antitrust semantics.

amendments.trigger: Synthetic attack showed that common title form 'FDA approves X' was rejected because base regex included approve/approved but not approves.
amendments.rule: FDA final action recognizes approve/approves/approval/approved and authorize/authorizes/authorization while preserving the advisory/final distinction.

precision_direction: No relaxation based on real v2 counts is permitted after the first real v2 execution. Any such change requires a new protocol version.
